title: SharedEvidenceQueryRequest
description: HR portal to Trust: POST /shared-evidence/query. Asks for evidence that learners have consented to share with this recipient for the listed competencies. It deliberately carries no thresholds: Trust never sees how a recruiter scores candidates, and the HR portal computes coverage itself. DRAFT 0.1.

request_id.description: Caller-generated. Returned in the response and written to the access log.

recipient_id.description: Must equal the authenticated caller's organisation. Trust rejects a mismatch.

role_version.description: Which version of the role this query served. Recorded for reproducibility only.

candidate_refs.description: Optional. Narrow to candidates the recipient has already seen. Refs it does not hold a grant for are silently omitted.
